component_requests.body:
## Owner adoption of MolI #75 and #80

Diego selected central policy work while leaving component changes to each development team (2026-11-04). This request changes no component file itself. Receive the exact central delivery recorded in https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/issues/75 and https://github.com/uibcdf/moli/issues/80; prepared canonical guide SHA-256: `618f79bff3d519e6949d5373aec4cf3bfaebeb1cbf7a8dba31f12cfd36665cf2`.

- [ ] Copy the exact published canonical MOLI_GUIDE.md byte-identically, preserving the immutable source/hash in your receipt.
- [ ] Preserve existing root AGENTS.md instructions and add the external-publication action: prior explicit permission from Diego Prada Gracia or Liliana Marisol Moreno Vargas before creating/publishing an issue or PR outside MolI scope or in a repository not owned by us, including remote draft PRs. Prepare the report/patch locally for review; without permission retain an internal finding/human handoff. Scoped authorization persists; internal direct-push/reporting authority and another fork/agent/account/tool cannot bypass the boundary. Link MOLI_GUIDE.md#external-issue-and-pull-request-authority.
- [ ] Add the release/package-event notice action to root AGENTS.md and the applicable local release closeout route. Every new component release (source-only included) and every package publication reports to uibcdf/moli. Update the same release-specific issue for later package/build events with exact version/source/tag/file/build/digest, actual public verification/limits and follow-up owners. Link MOLI_GUIDE.md#release-and-package-publication-notices and use the central notice template.
- [ ] Run applicable owner governance checks and MolI's registered check_component_guides.py/check_repository.py route; return the exact owner commit, checked guide equality, preserved local instruction review and actually executed native gates to BOTH central issues. Copying a guide or opening this issue is not future release compliance or scientific qualification.

The central normative documents are devguide/governance/external_publication_authority.md and release_publication_notices.md; concise root text is in devguide/templates/component_agent_instructions.md. Current guide-copy auditing stays active and truthfully reports outstanding copies until owner delivery.

No scientific implementation, package publication, dependency upgrade, shared environment change or Nextia runtime is requested. A scaffold still receives contributor instructions without inventing a publisher. MolSysSuite owns its independent member rollout in #129/#159; existing component release authority, advance impact notices, immutable tags/artifacts and private disclosure duties remain.
